hyperedges.label: Ways to Query the Knowledge Graph

nodes.label: build_merge()
nodes.rationale: build_merge reads graph.json directly without a NetworkX round-trip so edge direction (calls, implements, imports) is preserved (#801); prune_sources handles only genuinely deleted files since replace-on-re-extract already reconciles changed files.

nodes.label: graphify cluster-only
nodes.rationale: Self-contained: re-clusters, names communities, and regenerates all outputs from the existing graph alone, so Steps 5-9 (which need intermediate files already deleted by a prior build's cleanup) must not be re-run.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge (use AMBIGUOUS when unsure), never skip the corpus size warning, always show token cost, never hide cohesion scores, never run HTML viz on >5000 nodes without warning - trust and auditability over impressiveness.

nodes.label: Issue #1417 (manifest relativized to scan root)
nodes.rationale: Manifest keys are relativized to the scan root so the on-disk manifest is portable across clones/machines and --update matches cached files instead of missing every one after a move.

nodes.label: Issue #1948 (clear stale semantic_hash on failed chunk)
nodes.norm_label: issue #1948 (clear stale semantic_hash on failed chunk)
nodes.rationale: A changed doc/paper/image whose extraction chunk failed must have its stale semantic_hash cleared so the next --update re-queues it instead of treating it as already-processed and losing its content.

nodes.label: Issue #2015 (only stamp files that actually produced output)
nodes.norm_label: issue #2015 (only stamp files that actually produced output)
nodes.rationale: Only semantic files that actually produced extraction output get stamped as done in the manifest; a detected file whose chunk failed or was omitted must stay unstamped so it is retried next run.

nodes.label: Shrink Guard (#479)
nodes.rationale: to_json() refuses to write graph.json if the new graph has fewer nodes than the existing one, so an empty/partial extraction never silently overwrites a good graph.

nodes.label: save-result Feedback Loop
nodes.rationale: Saving Q&A back into the graph with an --outcome (useful/dead_end/corrected) closes a self-improving loop: the next --update extracts the Q&A as a node, and preferred sources / dead ends / corrections are recorded in LESSONS.md for future sessions.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Vocabulary Expansion
nodes.rationale: graphify query matches via case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming or synonyms; a wording mismatch between user question and graph label vocabulary collapses results to noise, so tokens must be expanded against the graph's own vocab first, never invented.

nodes.label: Confidence Score Rubric
nodes.rationale: Discrete confidence buckets (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) exist because production data showed models collapsing a continuous 0-1 range into a bimodal >50% at 0.5 / >40% at 0.85+ distribution; discrete rubrics are followed more faithfully.

nodes.label: Node ID Format ({stem}_{entity})
nodes.rationale: IDs must use the full repo-relative path (every directory level) so the semantic extractor's IDs match the AST extractor's IDs exactly; using only the filename or immediate parent creates orphan ghost-duplicate nodes.

nodes.label: Whisper Domain-Hint Prompt
nodes.rationale: The agent composes a one-sentence domain hint itself from god-node labels (no separate API call needed) and passes it to Whisper as the initial prompt to improve transcription accuracy on domain-specific terms.

nodes.label: Issue #1392 (write-from-Python / stale sidecar guards)
nodes.rationale: Multiple fixes bundled under one ticket: write JSON sidecars from Python (not shell redirects) to avoid console-encoding corruption; flatten only content files (not code) into semantic extraction; guard empty extraction before any write; PROJECT_ROOT (not scan dir) for chunk paths.
